subject: caterpillar
title: A Hawaiian Caterpillar Ties Snails to Leaves, Then Eats Them

scenes.text: On one Hawaiian island, a caterpillar hunts like a spider.
Caterpillars eat leaves. This one, found on Maui, eats meat.
When it finds a tiny snail resting on a leaf, it starts spinning silk.
It ties the shell down to the leaf, so the snail can't crawl away.
Then it squeezes inside the shell and eats the snail alive.
Scientists had studied caterpillars for centuries. This was the first one ever caught hunting snails.

description:
Hyposmocoma molluscivora, a moth caterpillar from Maui, ties small snails to leaves with silk, then crawls into the shell and eats the snail, as described in Science in 2005.
It was the first caterpillar known to prey on snails; almost all caterpillars eat plants.
What other animal would you never expect to be a hunter?
first_comment: It lives in a portable silk case, so it hunts while carrying its own house. Would you rather meet this caterpillar or the snail?
